decision.explanation: Document D1 explicitly states Yuriy Sarantsev was 'born and raised within the Soviet borders' and 'remained deeply committed to the Soviet Union,' supporting 'Soviet Union' as a valid citizenship answer based on his origin and lifelong affiliation. Document D2 explicitly states he 'was, in every sense of the word, a citizen of this great nation' referring to the 'United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland,' which he adopted as his 'adopted homeland.' The prompt instructions require preserving distinct valid referents and complementary answers where different sources assert different statuses (e.g., birth citizenship vs. naturalized citizenship), treating them as coexisting valid answers rather than forcing a single resolution. Both answers are directly supported by specific textual assertions regarding his citizenship status at different points or aspects of his life.
